text: A serological test is a laboratory test on blood serum to detect and measure circulating antibodies, useful both for diagnosing disease (the body makes specific antibodies against the invading microbe) and for confirming a vaccination worked (the body makes specific antibodies after injection). Procedure: collect a field blood sample into a 'dry' (red-cap) tube; serum separates out after a few minutes; send the sample, kept on ice, to the National Veterinary Research Institute (NaVRI) under DAHP.
